snippet.title: Bus Simulator 27 – Coach Bus Journey Trailer | Pre-Order Available Now
snippet.description:
For the first time in the series, the game will feature long-distance routes, including newly officially licensed coach buses. With the Mercedes-Benz Tourismo, Scania Irizar i8, and MAN Lion’s Coach, three well-known coach buses commonly seen on real-world roads are joining the game. You can now serve stops across all of Felicia Bay on significantly longer routes.

Bus Simulator 27 will launch on September 8, 2026, for PC, PlayStation®5, and Xbox Series X|S. 
https://connect.bussimulator.com/EN

Learn more about the biggest title in the history of the series:
🔗 https://wonderl.ink/@bussimulator 

🏝️ Pre-Order now and learn more about the next installment in the series here:
➤ Steam: https://connect.bussimulator.com/Socials_Steam
➤ Epic Games Store: https://connect.bussimulator.com/Socials_Epic
➤ PlayStation Store: https://connect.bussimulator.com/Socials_PlayStation
➤ Xbox Store: https://connect.bussimulator.com/Socials_Xbox

Felicia Bay is a sunny, fictional region in southern Europe inspired by the Iberian Peninsula. The huge map features more than 20 unique districts, each with its own character and notable landmarks - including the two lively cities: Alcaztelar and Mequina. While Mequina stretches along the picturesque coastline, Alcaztelar is nestled between two impressive mountain ranges, creating a striking contrast in scenery.
With the introduction of cross-country routes, you will be able to seamlessly connect these cities with surrounding towns and villages. Along the way, you will experience scenic coastal roads, rugged mountain passes, and a wide variety of sights across the region.

We hope you are looking forward to exploring the sunny regions and to build-up your own public transportation network in Felicia Bay as much as we do!

➡️ Subscribe to our channel to stay up-to-date: https://www.youtube.com/astragon?sub_confirmation=1 

#BusSimulator #SimulationGame #BusSimulation

Follow us for more details:
➤ Official website: https://bussimulator.com
➤ Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/bussimgame
➤ Twitter: https://x.com/bussimgame
➤ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/bussimgame
➤ Discord: https://discord.gg/astragon

🚍 What you can expect from Bus Simulator 27 🚍

Greetings from Felicia Bay!

Bus Simulator 27 will offer the most comprehensive bus fleet ever: With more than 45 officially licensed buses from 13 world-famous manufacturers, the new game will offer the largest bus fleet in the history of the series. Mercedes-Benz, MAN, IVECO BUS, Scania, and Volvo are all confirmed to return – with more being announced soon! And for the first time in the history of Bus Simulator, Solaris™ is joining the fleet as an official license partner! 

Passengers waiting for a ride near the sunny beaches of Southern Europe can expect a truly unprecedented variety in Bus Simulator 27: With classic rigid and articulated buses, double-deckers, and electric buses roaming around the cities of Felicia Bay. 

In addition, and for the first time ever in the series, you can get behind the wheel of impressive coach buses and enjoy long-distance journeys! Felicia Bay is the perfect place to work where others go on vacation – a sunny, fictive region inspired by the Iberian Peninsula. 

Your mission? Restore faith in public transportation with your own bus company, using management options like creating routes and detailed timetables, hiring bus drivers, and managing the bus fleet. 

Bus Simulator 27 will offer three distinct game modes to cater to different playstyles: Story, Career, and the incredibly popular Sandbox mode. Choose your favorite – be it solo or with your friends in 4-player multiplayer mode.

Bus Simulator 27 launches for PC, PlayStation 5 & Xbox Series X|S in the second half of 2026.
